title: Alpine Meadows Stables
specs: Official US Forest Service Partner with routes through Tahoe National Forest
Gentle, trail-trained horses for nervous and first-time riders
Guides knowledgeable about the trails and the area
Rides go through pine forests, meadows, creek crossings, and up Juniper Mountain
All children must be at least 6 years old for trail rides
Please notify staff if any rider weighs 225 lbs or more
Riders should be able to mount and dismount with minimal assistance (two-step mounting block provided)
Private rides available for just your group
includes: Friendly, knowledgeable guide(s) always escort rides
Mounting block provided for easy access
gap: Age minimums for Half Day, Mountain rides are listed as recommendations, not strict limits
blurb: Alpine Meadows Stables offers guided horseback riding experiences through the Tahoe National Forest, suited for beginners and experienced riders. Rides are led by knowledgeable, friendly guides and use gentle, trail-trained horses. The business is family owned and has operated for three generations. Rides range from short scenic tours and kids' pony rides to private and half-day adventures.
extraNote: Cash or check only—no credit cards · We kindly ask for 24–48 hours' notice if you won't be able to make your reservation · Rides only canceled for heavy wind or lightning; they will call you if that happens · Reservations by phone only, during business hours · Memorial Weekend through mid-October
